name: Kurouzu Tsumire
source:
Second year student from "Moon Academy", and one of this year's μ candidate. She's the successor of 蛇吾（ゲシュヴィント), one of three magic factors currently at war at Moon Academy.

Excelled at researching magic and had deep affection for Juuniji Ikoi.
